subject: Taxes
title: Tax Industry: TurboTax's Lobbying
description: A short lesson to help you apply Tax Industry: TurboTax's Lobbying.

hook.text: Intuit, maker of TurboTax, spent millions lobbying against free government tax filing.

buildup.text: The IRS has tried to create a free filing system since the 2000s. Intuit and H&R Block lobbied to block every attempt.

discovery.text: In 2019, probes found Intuit hid its free filing option from search engines while claiming 'free' filing existed.

twist.text: The IRS finally launched Direct File in 2024—against industry opposition. Intuit's stock dipped on the news.

climax.text: The tax prep industry profits from complexity it helps maintain.

punchline.text: Tax complexity as a business model. TurboTax lobbied to keep it hard.

quiz.question: Why did Intuit lobby against free government tax filing?
options: Tax complexity is their business model
They believed the IRS couldn't handle it
